cs.t:
My new, portable coffee setup : an aeropress and a grinder (1zpresso q2 mini). I'm making coffee everyday with this and it's been great. I used to think espresso was the only option, but espresso tools are not easily portable and I tend to switch country every year or so.
I also bought a portable 15inch screen for my laptop, not as good as expected but still a good use of 90€
